title: 911 calls from the facility intercepted
summary: Jordan Jose tells of 911 calls from the facility intercepted, about c. 2008–2010 at Baker Victory Services, Western New York, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: like get out, call 911 from the school facility, but the lines were surveiled.

plain: Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into a secret UFO-related programme as a child, tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about his time around 2008 to 2010 at Baker Victory Services, a children's facility in Western New York. He says that when children tried to get out or call 911, the US emergency number, from the school facility, the phone lines were being watched. If true, it would mean the place was secretly controlled by those running the programme.
